messages:
Alex: Kicking off a staggered canary now — plan is 2% -> 6% -> 12% over ~40m. Change window is live. deploy-bot will post progress.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: release=rls-2026-09-pt1, target=2%, cohort=canary, leader=alex. ETA 5m for first ramp.

Maria: Saw a small spike in 502s on eu-west-1 during last smoke run. Keeping an eye. If it creeps >1.5% we should hold.

Cheng: Which metric series are we using for the gate? p50/p95 latency + 502 rate? Need the exact thresholds.

Alex: Gate = (502_rate > 1.5% for 3m) OR (p95_latency > 450ms vs baseline +20%) -> hold. Also watch embed-failure-rate.

lena: Adding synthetic trace for a few endpoints to the dashboard now — will post screenshots if anything odd.

deploy-bot: Ramp to 6% complete. Observed: p95 +8%, 502_rate 0.9%, embed-failure 0.2%.

Maria: Noted a micro-burst of 502s at minute 2 of the 6% window (0.6% spike). Might be noise but monitor closely.

Cheng: Can we get a quick K/V cache saturation check? Past deploys showed correlation.

ops-runner: KV cache at 72% avg, no evictions. CPU on inference pods steady.

Alex: Given metrics, I'm leaning continue to 12% but with a short hold at 10% if any drift. Agree?

Maria: +1 but request pin at 10% so we can quickly roll back the cohort if needed.

deploy-bot: Starting ramp to 12% (intermediate 10% checkpoint).

deploy-bot: Checkpoint @10% reached. Current: p95 +12% (baseline), 502_rate 1.4% (trend +0.2%).

Cheng: p95 trend worries me — could be tail amplification. Recommend hold and run quick sample compare on older model variant for 10m.

Alex: OK hold at 10% and pin cohort. No further ramps. Maria, please prepare rollback signal if 502_rate breaches 1.6% or p95 > 480ms sustained 5m.

Maria: Preparing rollback playbook now. Notifying CS for potential customer impact. @lena pls capture dashboards. :eyes:

lena: Saved dashboard snapshot and shared link: https://dashboards.internal/r/rls-2026-09-pt1/snapshot.

deploy-bot: Cohort pinned at 10%. Rollback triggers configured.

ops-runner: I'll schedule a 10-min pause + telemetry deep-dive. If we need to revert, we can flip the route in <3m.

Alex: Thanks everyone — keeping this thread as the checkpoint. If metrics stabilize in 10m we can discuss resuming. Otherwise rollback plan is ready.

Maria: Will update in 8m with analysis.

Cheng: Standby for hypothesized root cause (KV hotness vs kernel scheduler). Will post results.

deploy-bot: Note: Release notes (rls-2026-09-pt1) uploaded to release-tracker.

Alex: Closing loop: no rollback yet. We'll reconvene on next signal. :thumbsup:
